local_review.finding_body: The test build hardcoded Spring Boot support modules to 4.1.1, so the suite would not keep those modules aligned with the TCK-selected tested version, and it added spring-boot-docker-compose even though no test exercised that integration. This violated the version-agnostic and minimal-scope test requirements; the successful finalization pass confirmed the unused dependency was unnecessary.
local_review.finding_title: Version-pinned and unused Spring Boot test dependencies
local_review.fix_note: Changed spring-boot-testcontainers to use $libraryVersion, removed the unused spring-boot-docker-compose dependency, and accepted the regenerated stable library statistics.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the single-coordinate diff and local gate evidence. The tests exercise public Spring Boot/OpenTelemetry behavior from a separate package, contain no scaffold placeholder, Native Image skip/tolerance, version assertion, visibility bypass, or legacy metadata format. Reported dynamic access is the valid 0/0 no-calls case, so the percentage and entry-count mismatch probes do not apply. The repaired tree passed the Forge finalizer's three Native Image lanes, metadata and style checks, generated-test validation, and stable statistics regeneration with no further publishable changes.
